verdict.rationale: The pricing page advertises "Unlimited message history" but never ties it to the free tier, so it gives no credit for keeping history on a free plan. Community reports say free workspaces have message and storage limits, and that without paying, history "disappears after a few thousand messages." The applicable axis is therefore unmet.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
